name: auth-login-audit
title: Authentication Login Audit Signal
description: Draft observability signal instance for authentication login audit correlation. The first assurance slice uses this runtime-event signal to connect request trace identity, audit event identity, tenant context, provider mode, and future proof output without claiming OpenTelemetry compliance.
aiGuidance: Signal names and attributes are USF-controlled and OpenTelemetry-informed; do not claim OpenTelemetry compliance from this instance.
purpose: Correlate login audit decisions with request, trace, tenant, provider-mode, capability, and proof identifiers for the authentication login slice.
retention: retained according to audit and observability policy once evidence retention is authored
correlation: request-id links login interface, authentication workflow, audit event, observability signal, and proof output; trace-id and proof-id must agree with collected proof evidence when a proof claim depends on this signal
